hook.say: Five geography questions. Three seconds each. Most people miss number five!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.fact: Canberra was built to settle the rivalry between Sydney and Melbourne.
questions.sayAnswer: Canberra! It was built to settle the rivalry between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.q: Which is the smallest country in the world?
questions.fact: Vatican City covers less than half a square kilometer.
questions.sayAnswer: Vatican City! It covers less than half a square kilometer.

questions.q: Which is the largest desert on Earth?
questions.fact: A desert is defined by low rainfall, and Antarctica is the driest continent.
questions.sayAnswer: Antarctica! A desert just means very little rain, and it is the driest continent.

questions.q: Which country has the most time zones?
questions.fact: France has 12, thanks to its overseas territories. Russia has 11.
questions.sayAnswer: France! It has twelve, thanks to its overseas territories. Russia has eleven.

questions.q: Which country has the most islands?
questions.fact: Sweden has more than 260,000 islands. Most are uninhabited.
questions.sayAnswer: Sweden! It has more than 260,000 islands, and most are uninhabited.
